name: const unsafe fn copy < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: The copied data need not be initialized or satisfy the validity requirements of `T`; `copy` preserves its initialization state exactly.
api: const unsafe fn copy < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in this DSL: exact preservation of initialization state requires pre-call and post-call observations, but only current-state observations are available.
